title: Clandestine Christian ex-special-forces group approaches the congressman
summary: Eric Burlison tells of Clandestine Christian ex-special-forces group approaches the congressman, about c. 2024-2026 at Washington, D.C., and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: they kind of bumped me is the best way to describe it in Washington DC with a at a different meeting.

plain: Eric Burlison, a US congressman, told podcast host Jesse Michels in 2026 that a secretive group of Christian former special forces soldiers made contact with him in Washington, DC, sometime around 2024 to 2026. He says they "bumped" him, approaching him in passing at a different meeting. If true, it would suggest that private, hidden groups with military backgrounds are trying to shape what lawmakers learn about UFOs.
